units: Recall percentages; sample standard deviation over training seeds unless stated

human_review.limitation: Historical source-image audit only; not representative target-visibility ground truth

P0.interpretation: Different frames do not guarantee low overlap; heading/time are metadata descriptors, not visibility ground truth

P1.interpretation: Different frames do not guarantee low overlap; heading/time are metadata descriptors, not visibility ground truth

human_retrieval_lock.T2I: Full original P1 test target-image gallery; same-place positives
human_retrieval_lock.I2T: Diagnostic one-caption-per-place gallery; replace focus-place caption per human item; average both target-image queries
human_retrieval_lock.label_scope: Visibility refers to either displayed target image; I2T results average individual target views
